611:t_024:51.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The decisive battle at $$ラース・バビロン$$... Is it a fight that stakes the future...?」

611:t_024:52.en:
$$甲児$$
「We'll win...! This time for sure.」

611:t_024:53.en:
$$刹那$$
「To carve out the future of this world.」

611:t_024:54.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Just you wait, $$サイデリアル$$. The day we drive you out of Earth is coming soon.」

611:t_025:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I-I won't stop! The fight of $$ハイアデス$$ will not end in a place like this!」

611:t_025:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Please wait for me, Lady $$エルーナ$$! Your beloved $$ダバラーン$$ will be at your side at once...!」

611:t_026:0.en:
$$メール$$
「...Do you think that guy... died...?」

611:t_026:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「If there's such a thing as the power of love, he'll stubbornly survive.」

611:t_026:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「But we knocked down his prized battleship. I doubt we'll have to fight him again.」

611:t_026:3.en:
$$メール$$
「Even if he comes back, we'll be fine!」

611:t_026:4.en:
$$メール$$
「Because Darling has the power of love too!」

611:t_027:0.en:
$$尸刻$$
「I apologize, Brother. It seems my power was not enough...」

611:t_027:1.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Perhaps they might even be capable of overturning the natural order...」

611:t_028:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
(You're the one whose job is guiding human souls to the underworld. I can't see you dying that easily...)

611:t_028:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
(See you, $$尸刻$$... Sorry, but I'm going to settle things with your brother.)

611:t_029:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Damn! How dare you do this to me...!」

611:t_029:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...Not being able to sustain hatred and anger like that... is it my age, I wonder...」

611:t_030:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
($$サルディアス$$... Do you approve of $$バルビエル$$ continuing to fight like this...?)

611:t_030:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
(If he keeps being swallowed by hatred like this, what awaits is surely sorrow that can never be undone...)

611:t_100:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「$$ランド・トラビス$$! The time has finally come to settle things with you!」

611:t_100:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「I was ready anytime, but you're the one who ran off, weren't you...?」

611:t_100:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That was what's known as a strategic withdrawal! But today I'll go all the way!」

611:t_100:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I'll acknowledge that you're a worthy opponent to set my $$ハイアデス$$ spirit ablaze!」

611:t_100:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「All right! That feels more like a man's fight than taking your jealousy out on everyone!」

611:t_100:5.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Has your fighting instinct caught fire? That's the spirit!」

611:t_100:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Bring it, $$ダバラーン$$! $$ガンレオン$$ and I will meet you with everything we've got!!」

611:t_100:7.en:
$$メール$$
「In the end, these two... are two of a kind...」

611:t_101:0.en:
$$尸刻$$
「$$クロウ・ブルースト$$... I cannot let you advance any further.」

611:t_101:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「A sister who cares about her brother, huh. But neither words nor force will stop me.」

611:t_101:2.en:
$$尸刻$$
「I know that. That strong will is your very essence, and it is the reason I don't want you to fight $$尸空#pilot$$.」

611:t_101:3.en:
$$尸刻$$
「It would cast a shadow over $$尸空#pilot$$'s void.」

611:t_101:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Sorry... Bending the way I live for someone else's sake isn't my way.」

611:t_101:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm coming through, $$尸刻$$! Partly to settle things with $$尸空#pilot$$, too!」

611:t_102:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$サルディアス$$! You regard $$バルビエル$$ as...!」

611:t_102:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It's as you surmise, $$セツコ$$. To me he is my superior, someone to be feared, and also a subject of observation.」

611:t_102:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Perhaps it's from having been a scholar... It seems that curiosity wins out over hatred in me.」

611:t_102:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「So show me, $$セツコ$$. Show me, who in the end could not be fully steeped in hatred, whether sorrow can heal hatred.」

611:t_102:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...I would like to say that, but it's my job, so I will stop you all here.」

611:t_102:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...I don't know if I can stop him...」

611:t_102:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But we have to keep moving forward! We're getting through here!」

611:t_103:0.en:
$$トライア$$
「Well now... this ship isn't built for combat, you know...」

611:t_103:1.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「No need to worry, Doctor!」

611:t_103:2.en:
$$トビー$$
「We're on close escort for the $$ソーラリアン$$!」

611:t_103:3.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「We will protect the ship!」

611:t_103:4.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「It's enough if the Doctor and $$ＡＧ$$ concentrate on controlling events.」

611:t_103:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「But I can't stand letting a pack of riffraff damage the $$ソーラリアン$$, completed through the efforts of so many people! I'll do everything I can too!」

611:t_103:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「OK, $$トライア$$! Let's give it our all!」

611:t_104:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
(Lady $$エルーナ$$...! I will surely deliver word of victory to $$ラース・バビロン$$!)

611:t_104:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
(And when that time comes, $$ダバラーン・タウ$$ will put my whole body and soul into pouring out all my feelings to Lady $$エルーナ$$!)

611:t_105:1.en:
$$尸刻$$
(Countless deaths, enough to warp dimensions... Where is this universe trying to go...?)

611:t_106:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(Well now... the decisive battle at last...)

611:t_106:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(If I win, it's the end of Earth... If I lose, I won't get to see the battles after this...)

611:t_106:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(Whatever the outcome, it's a shame that this is as far as I get to watch the battle between Earth and the $$サイデリアル$$...)
